name: lythospile
summary: Axial capacity of piles in layered ground: shaft friction by the α, β and λ methods and K·σ'v·tan δ, base resistance by Meyerhof, Vesić and Janbu, the pile's weight, the water table, group efficiency and block failure, the required length, the settlement of a pile and of a group, rock-socketed piles by every published side shear correlation with their elastic settlement, and parametric / reliability studies with PDF reporting.
